announcements.title: Autopilot rolls out to Frontier customers

announcements.title: Agents and Workflows in Copilot Managed Runtime

announcements.title: Copilot Managed Runtime generally available

announcements.title: Fabric data backend for Copilot Managed Runtime

announcements.title: Copilot Pages

announcements.title: Copilot sales skills across PowerPoint and Cowork

announcements.title: Copilot in OneDrive generally available

announcements.title: Copilot in OneNote creates Office files from notes

announcements.title: Plugin Catalog and business function plugins

announcements.title: Copilot Workspaces

announcements.title: Home in the Microsoft Copilot app

announcements.title: Office in Copilot (Word, Excel, PowerPoint inside the Copilot app)

announcements.title: Today (Today Brief and Today Feed)
announcements.availability: Rolling out now; no GA date
announcements.summary: Personalised morning briefing and a feed that refreshes through the day from email, chats and meetings, with prepared drafts and scheduling proposals. In Outlook and the Copilot app. Recurring feed updates use Copilot Credits.

announcements.title: Agentic Users in Teams
announcements.summary: Agents can join a team under their own Microsoft Entra account with an accountable owner and admin controls. People add them to chats, channels and meetings and @mention them; actions are attributed to the agent in audit logs and reviewable in Agent 365.

announcements.title: Streaming and extended Markdown for agents in Teams

announcements.title: Teams AI phishing, deepfake, impersonation and QR-code protections
announcements.availability: Phishing detection GA mid-Dec 2026; impersonation warnings mid-Dec 2026
announcements.summary: AI phishing detection in chats, third-party deepfake detection in meetings, impersonation warnings and malicious QR-code detection in Teams messages.
announcements.verification: Official docs (Defender for Office 365 what's new)

announcements.title: Teams agent threads, plans and steps, HTML widgets and socket mode
announcements.summary: Threaded replies keep each task in a one-to-one agent chat separate; agent plans and steps show progress on multistep tasks; HTML widgets embed interactive views in responses; socket mode lets developers test an agent without a public endpoint or tunnel (new agents, development only).

announcements.title: Automated file-level archive and inactive file policy in SharePoint
announcements.summary: Automated file-level archive with Microsoft 365 Archive is GA (policies through PowerShell or the SharePoint Admin Agent); the SharePoint Advanced Management inactive file policy is in public preview.

announcements.title: Multi-Geo default geo move for SharePoint and OneDrive

announcements.title: SharePoint Admin Agent
announcements.summary: Natural-language tenant analysis and guided remediation. The agent and its Permissions and Oversharing, Lifecycle, Storage, Multi-Geo and Catalog skills are generally available; the Agent Access Heatmap for SharePoint and OneDrive reaches GA in December 2026.

announcements.title: SharePoint App Intelligence and Content Events
announcements.availability: App Intelligence GA December 2026; Content Events private preview
announcements.summary: App Intelligence in the SharePoint admin center shows which apps can reach content, their permission scope and observed activity, working with the SharePoint Admin Agent. Content Events (SharePoint Advanced Management) alerts on mass deletions, mass downloads and oversharing.

announcements.title: SharePoint Governance Hub for admins and site owners
announcements.availability: Admins: GA December 2026; site owners: public preview now
announcements.summary: Governance Hub in the SharePoint admin center Home tab, powered by the SharePoint Admin Agent, brings assessments, findings, recommendations and tasks together (GA December 2026). A Governance Reviews Dashboard for site owners shows pending inactivity, ownership, attestation and access reviews (public preview).

announcements.title: SharePoint Work IQ context enhancements

announcements.title: SharePoint restricted access for apps and agents and agentic user collaboration limits

announcements.title: SharePoint storage pay-as-you-go meter and tenant-wide version trimming

announcements.title: SharePoint tools in Work IQ and the Copilot app

announcements.title: Communities in Teams generally available

announcements.title: Viva Engage communication plans

announcements.title: Viva Engage plugin and 17 skills for Copilot Cowork

announcements.title: Agent 365 Action Center

announcements.title: Connected platforms wizard and secretless authentication

announcements.title: Dynamic Agent Risk

announcements.title: Local and shadow agent discovery

announcements.title: Intune Enterprise App Management, Windows Server management and local agent controls
announcements.summary: Automatic updates for all Windows apps, Windows Server 2028 management and local AI agent governance controls in preview.

announcements.title: Intune Vulnerability Remediation Agent
announcements.summary: Combines Defender vulnerability intelligence with Intune device and app context to build and run remediation playbooks for app and OS patching; available in Microsoft Perception's Reduce Risk Exposure playbook and in the Intune admin center.

announcements.title: Copilot on Windows and Hybrid Intelligence
announcements.summary: Copilot uses local PC context and actions, offloads to local models; Hybrid Intelligence preview in GitHub Copilot tools on Copilot+ PCs.

announcements.title: Microsoft Execution Containers updates
announcements.summary: Process containers and learning mode GA, experimental local micro-VMs; OpenAI and Meta building on MXC.

announcements.title: Windows baseline protection
announcements.summary: Applies and maintains critical security settings from boot, including Secure Boot and VBS.

announcements.title: Windows endpoint security platform and administrator protection
announcements.summary: Security products protect devices outside the kernel; administrator protection GA.

announcements.title: Windows 365 Direct Stream, local AI Cloud PCs and context-based redirection
announcements.summary: Direct Stream improvements GA, Cloud PCs up to 32 vCPU and GPU for local AI GA, context-based redirection GA; admin assistant and Windows MAM in preview.

announcements.title: Edge for Business security: Sentinel connector, Global Secure Access, extension safety
announcements.summary: Sentinel connector and Global Secure Access without VPN in preview; extension safety GA; extension leak control in preview.

announcements.title: Edge for Business skills recorder and managed agent browsing
announcements.summary: Record workflows as Cowork skills; force Microsoft and third-party agents to use Edge for Business with their own Entra agent identity.

announcements.title: Edge for Business writing assistance and Journeys
announcements.licensing: Microsoft 365 Copilot licence (work grounding for writing assistance; Journeys)
announcements.summary: Writing assistance drafts and edits text in any form field using Work IQ context; Journeys (Get things done on the new tab page) suggests next steps on workstreams. Both in preview.

announcements.title: Dynamics 365 Activate extends to agentic ERP migration
announcements.summary: Starts with SAP ECC migration in private preview; Salesforce CRM migration GA.

announcements.title: Dynamics 365 CRM and ERP plugins in Copilot
announcements.summary: Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service plugins (57+ skills) and ERP apps plugin (39+ finance and operations skills, with Excel) GA.

announcements.title: Dynamics 365 ERP and Copilot Cowork in Business Applications in Work IQ
announcements.summary: Finance and operations data from Dynamics 365 ERP apps comes to Copilot Chat, Agent Builder, Copilot Studio and the Work IQ MCP server, and Copilot Cowork can brief and update across Dynamics 365 Sales, Customer Service and ERP apps; both in public preview. Business skills learning in Power Apps is coming to public preview soon.

announcements.title: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence
announcements.summary: Microsoft voice and digital agents layered onto Genesys, Five9, Avaya and Webex platforms.

announcements.title: Copilot in canvas apps generally available
announcements.summary: Copilot in canvas apps reaches general availability this November, grounded in the app's data and permissions. Copilot in model-driven apps became generally available in April 2026.

announcements.title: Business applications in Work IQ
announcements.licensing: Copilot Chat use included in Microsoft 365 Copilot; agents in Copilot Studio and Cowork and Work IQ MCP/API calls billed by usage
announcements.summary: Generally available from 18 Nov 2026 (announced in public preview on 17 Nov). Grounds Copilot and agents in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform data: business context in Copilot Chat, Agent Builder and Copilot Studio, business skills and auto-generated semantic models in Dataverse, the Work IQ MCP server, CLI and Dataverse Ask API, and admin controls in the Microsoft 365 and Power Platform admin centers. Changes stay within each user's permissions.

announcements.title: Hybrid authoring of apps and flows with agents through MCP servers
announcements.summary: Makers and developers can bring agents into new and existing apps and flows from GitHub Copilot, Power Platform studios, Copilot and Cowork; agents build with Power Platform controls through MCP servers and the results stay governed like other solutions.

announcements.title: Power Platform quality and maker improvements
announcements.summary: New canvas modern controls, new model-driven views (calendar, cards, timeline), delegation limit extended to 10,000 items, detachable formula bar, grid container, inline views in cloud flows and Flowchart and Flow Map views in Power Automate desktop. Microsoft reports 80 million monthly users.

announcements.title: Copilotforce: Salesforce in Copilot, Teams and Fabric
announcements.summary: Salesforce in Copilot plugin in preview (38+ sales skills, Salesforce MCP); Sales Cloud in Teams in pilot; Data 360 federation from OneLake GA and sharing into OneLake in public preview.

announcements.title: AI Builder capacity add-ons retired from sale
announcements.summary: Existing credits usable to end of term; customers directed to Copilot Credits.

announcements.title: Business Central and Copilot Business CSP bundles
announcements.summary: Permanent bundles for up to 300 seats, saving USD 6 per user per month.

announcements.title: Usage-based billing on by default for new Copilot Business CSP purchases
announcements.summary: Default spending limit of 4,000 Copilot Credits per user per month, adjustable by admins.

announcements.title: Copilot offers purchasable without a Microsoft 365 base licence
announcements.summary: New Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Business offers can be bought without a qualifying base subscription; add-on offers end sale in CSP.

announcements.title: Custom Solutions for Microsoft Teams specialization retired
announcements.summary: No new enrolments or renewals; active until anniversary date.

announcements.title: Sovereign Private Cloud specialization
announcements.summary: Azure Local for Hybrid and Sovereign Private Cloud specialization launched.

announcements.title: Purview Data Governance retirement
announcements.summary: Unified Catalog, Data Map and Workflows retiring; governance consolidates in Fabric and the OneLake catalog. Data security and compliance unchanged.
